167475.overview: There are three modes. "Queen's Palace" where you can play seriously with 12 female professional quizzes without squid, "Free game" where you can easily play with your favorite professionals according to your favorite rules, challenge the difficult problems that professionals thought Equipped with "Queen's Quiz". Of course, red tiles can also be inserted.

167476.overview: Nurturing mahjong game. Choose one of the eight unique characters that appear, and play mahjong games to grow. By winning with mahjong, you will grow and transform and learn various special skills. There are three game modes: "Enthusiastic! 100 games", "Unlimited games", and "Free games". You can select 2-player, 3-player, or 4-player in all modes. Original rules are set to eliminate the differences caused by the rules that differ from region to region.

167477.overview: A fashion adventure game that collects cute clothes and develops a sense of the main character. The main character, Witch Mari, is a junior high school student in a magical country. With Mari-chan's caretaker cat (Mimi), she will practice Sense UP for one year on Earth. Mari, who can't use magic other than making clothes on the earth, lives as 18 years old. You can make friends by going to parks and shops, and idolizing, and you can inspire wonderful clothes. Draw the inspirational clothes on your sketchbook at home and put the finished design in the trunk to complete. If you make more friends, you will be invited to an event such as a party on Saturday and Sunday. Over 190 clothes can be remembered. The first item in the game is a coordinated set from hairstyle to shoes.

167478.overview: McDonald's clerk impersonator game! Players will be assigned to McDonald's "Happy Town Store" as a store manager apprentice. For three years here, I will work hard to become a store manager by improving the skills of five part-time workers, aiming for a store that is loved by the people of the city. Improve your skills and part-time job skills with 5 types of mini-games such as "cash register" and "hamburger cooking". Fun events occur by communicating with part-time workers and people in the city! Love, marriage and a wonderful life await! If you input the menu you want to eat today, the combination will tell you today's fortune.

167479.overview: Extrasensory RPG to play with "Henshin". The story is that the main character, who longs for the justice group "Kools" that protects the peace and security of the world, trains and joins the army. Let's adventure while transforming into various shapes with the help of "Metamode", a funny, cute and strange guy. There are 90 characters that can be transformed. You can combine it with your favorite appearance and about 500 kinds of techniques such as "Night", "Archer", and "Shinobi". In addition, you can play two players using Game Boy RPG's first communication. You can also defeat monsters with your friends and teach each other how to proceed on the map. There are treasure chests, tools, and maps that can only be entered during communication.

167480.overview: A shogi game suitable for beginners who are about to start shogi. The mode is "Shogi game function", which allows you to obtain the official diploma issued by the Japan Shogi Association for the first time by clearing the official league with a story, 200 recording problems, and you can enjoy tsume shogi from 1 to 5 tsume shogi. "Tsume shogi questioning function", "shogi technical term search function" that explains difficult technical terms in an easy-to-understand manner, and "communication battle function" that allows you to play against your friends.

167481.overview: "Minnie & Friends" is a game where you advance your adventure while using email. Email is indispensable for Minnie to solve the mystery of adventure in advancing the game. In addition to the main character Minnie Mouse, 10 characters including Pluto, Donald, Goofy, Chip & Dale, May, Jun, and April have appeared. In addition, the original characters of "Minnie & Friends" will also appear! There are 13 types of mini-games in the middle of the adventure, and after clearing each mini-game, you can play any number of times by selecting "mini-game" on the menu screen.

167482.overview: One day, the hero gets a mysterious bill. From that day on, he gets caught up in the turmoil over the resurrection of the anciently sealed demons hidden behind the eerie card game "New Youkai Den". The hero travels all over Japan to prevent the demon from resurrection. There are four game modes: "story mode", "fighting mode", "battle mode", and "trading mode". In "Battle Mode" and "Trading Mode", you can play and exchange with your friends using a communication cable. There are 298 types of cards by Shigeru Mizuki, the best youkai painter of our time!

167483.overview: Once upon a time. Born from peaches, Momotaro was carefully raised by his grandfather and grandmother and grew up quickly. One day, Onigashima's oni and others began to attack villages here and there. Momotaro, accompanied by dogs, monkeys, and pheasants, headed for Onigashima, where Enma the Great was waiting, in order to ward off Oni, who bothers people. Peace has returned to the village thanks to Momotaro, who made the great Enma the Great. However! It has been three years since peace returned to the world. Once again, the evil hand has come to an end. The next enemy is the hell king who is in hell deeper than Enma the Great. Momotaro departs again and challenges the battle with the encouraging friends he meets during the journey. Will we be able to regain peace this time as well? ?? , "Momotaro Densetsu" and "Momotaro Densetsu II" have become one epic story and appeared exclusively for GBC. Two software as one story, one with new elements. "Time capsule" that allows you to raise the status value according to the level of Momotaro after the Enma the Great, and "Time capsule" that you can take out the tool in the middle of the trip if you put the tool in the well Full of new systems such as "System", "Point Card System" that allows you to shop with points you collect when you shop, and "Oni Zukan" that collects the collected cards in an album! It is also equipped with a "Kyukei" command that allows you to temporarily save anytime, anywhere, and an "auto mapping function" that allows you to view maps. Re-released as a low-priced version on July 31, 2001.

167484.overview: Monster * Race 2 is a Role-Playing game, published by Koei, which was released in Japan in 1999.

167485.overview: The evolution of a total of 150 monsters changes depending on what kind of training the player gives to the monsters. If you practice attacking, you will grow into an aggressive monster, and if you practice defending, you will grow into a defensive monster. In addition, a 3-player vs. 3-player battle is realized! The number of patterns for one character is as diverse as 30 patterns, and the character walks, hits, jumps, and performs various actions! In addition, instead of the conventional world view, the stage is set to "universe" to provide a new world view. Katsuhisa Hattori is in charge of the music! !! Wonderful sounds will liven up this world!

167486.overview: An exhilarating action simulation game in which the "invincible" Trizenon defeats the enemy robots of Zenon Palace, which has begun to invade the earth. With graphics approaching anime, attractive characters are appearing one after another! Easy operation that even children can easily play!

183078.overview:
Metal Slug 2001 is a pirate game for the Game Boy Color released in 2001, based on Metal Slug 1st Mission with some aspects from the sequel.

The character starts with Gimlet, the levels are similar to 1st Mission. There are different bosses based on the original arcade game. The music is similar to several Mega Man games. Two versions exist; an incomplete ROM without the ending, less levels and bosses; and a full game with double the amount of levels, more bosses and an ending.

183081.overview:
Monster Go! Go! Go!! is a hack of The Smurfs 3 released in the late 1990s for the Game Boy Color. The Smurfs 3 was originally in monochrome, but was colorized in this hack - it was later re-released officially in color as The Smurfs Nightmare, and a subsequent version of the hack was based on this release.

Almost all the graphics from the original game are replaced, and so does the intro and ending text. Bizarrely, the intro text appears to be replaced with a poorly translated version of My Heart Will Go On by Céline Dion. Aside from the title screen, the game's use of color is limited, which gives it the appearance of a Super Game Boy game. The game suffers from extreme slowdown, running consistently at about half speed, possibly due to the colorization process.

190921.overview:
The Mobile Trainer is the operation software for Nintendo and Mobile21's now defunct (as of December 14, 2002) Mobile System GB service, designed for both Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance.

It was first released on January 27, 2001 (originally planned for December 2000) with a recommended retail price of ¥5800, before a price cut to ¥3800 from July 19, 2001. By late March 2001, Nikkei reported that Nintendo had only sold 80,000 units; the reason provided was that the only game to extensively use the Mobile Game Boy Adapter at the time was Pokémon Crystal, which was targeted at a younger audience whom may not have access to a mobile phone.

The Mobile Trainer was originally planned to be released as the Mobile Starter Cartridge, but the name was later changed, perhaps to allude to Pokémon Trainers, as the Japanese Pokémon Crystal Version was one of the intended games to use it.

The Mobile Trainer was intended to be used for the combination of a peripheral known as the Mobile GB Adapter and Japanese mobile phones to connect to the World Wide Web, similar to services such as Satellaview, Randnet and its successors such as the Nintendo Network. This included games relevant to the Mario series, such as Mobile Golf and the Japanese version of Mario Kart: Super Circuit.

The Mobile Trainer's main purpose was as operation software for configuring the Game Boy Color with the user's mobile phone. However, the Mobile Trainer could also be used to connect to a limited web browser for news, and to send email between friends.

191215.overview:
Matel Gear II (合金裝備II) is an unlicensed video game for the Game Boy Color developed and published by Sintax. The game was likely released some time in 2003 based on the ID printed on the boxes for the Chinese releases (200313519).

Matel Gear II rips off the popular Metal Gear video game series, though this game's beat-'em-up style of gameplay greatly differs from the stealth that the Metal Gear game series typically offered. This game was released in both Chinese and English, with the former being released in both Taiwan and mainland China, and the latter only known to have been released in parts of Asia.

204391.overview:
Unreleased, found in the September 2020 leaks.

Mattel's latest action hero lends perfectly to the Game Boy as he makes his gaming debut. Max must battle the evil forces of the D.R.E.A.D. organisation and rid the world of the terrorist threat. Max tackles his way through 11 rolling levels, battling such enemies as Vitriol, Psycho and Alecto Bane. Control Max in his MX25 Attack Jet, or help him infiltrate a secret hideout by swimming underwater.

- Boss Levels - Fight numerous bosses throughout the game.
- Strategic Missions - Complete secret covert missions from HQ.
- Multiple Languages - Supports English, French, Spanish and German.

207310.overview:
This is a homebrew game, run on Game Boy Color. Original version: Jason Perkins and Terry Droid - Gremlin Graphics. Commodore 16/Plus4, 1986. Created with GB-Studio 2.0.0 beta5!

Monty having escaped from prison and now superfit so that he can quickly make his way to freedom through many hideouts and secret locations. The gold coins located throughout the game must be collected by Monty to enable hime to escape to freedom.

The Game Boy Color version is based on Jason Perkins's Commodore 16 conversion.
Title music from Auf Wiedersehen Monty.

Also available for download in .CIA format for the Nintendo 3DS virtual console!

208771.overview: Mud Warriors is a narrative adventure game with a focus on story and exploration. It is also a Gameboy adaptation of Ryan's original text adventure game.

214926.overview: In The Machine, you’ll have the opportunity to pursue numerous different storyline paths, leading to one of over 25 possible endings. In this original dystopian world, explore the inner workings of a gigantic machine and the people who inhabit it in the throes of an election that could dramatically shape the future. In this hierarchical society, your place in the world is determined at a young age through an aptitude test, which will allow you to experience each playthrough as a factory worker, a police officer, or more. Get to know those around you, and make decisions that could dramatically impact the future of your home and its inhabitants.

217638.overview:
In Magic and Legend: Time Knights, players will follow the tale of the titular heroes as they travel through time to fight off malevolent invaders. 

Both Magic and Legend feature their own unique set of abilities, letting players experiment with the right tactics and get a feel of the playstyle that suits them best. Of course, in case they can't make up their minds (because both are equally fun to use), they can always switch between the two characters at any time on the fly.

The game features 5 large sprawling levels over the time periods:
- Level 1: The Journey Begins... (Present Day)
- Level 2: Medieval Times
- Level 3: Sengoku Period
- Level 4: Ancient Rome
- Level 5: The Crown Jewel Heist (60's London)

For each level Magic and Legend have their own costumes and weapons and just for fun there are also 4 bonus levels.

Lastly, to ensure the world is safe, the boys go up against a final boss who is hell bent on taking on taking out Magic & Legend so they can take the planet for themselves.

Physical copies can be purchased at RetroRoomgames: https://theretroroomgames.com/products/magic-legend-time-knights
Digital is available on itch.io: https://ghamson.itch.io/timeknights

218524.overview:
One of the most beloved (and overlooked) Mega Man games, can now be played in full color!

This patch transforms the classic Game Boy game into a Game Boy Color game.

FEATURES

Fully colorized game
No slowdowns!
NES styled pause screen
Works in real hardware and emulators

448009.overview: The first in the IF series developed by HabitSoft under license from City Connection Co., Ltd.! It was planned and developed based on the concept of what would happen if the arcade version of Moe Pro Home Run Competition was ported to GB. Compete to see how many home runs you can hit in a 10-ball game! In addition, as a Habit Soft original, you can edit players, and a special password appears as a reward for achieving perfection in each of the three modes. If you enter a special password, you can play as a Legend player. Special passwords will be randomly displayed for a total of 12 players, 4 for each difficulty level. Please try to make it perfect!

448898.overview:
As Yuu, the former mayor of Anzen, you had hoped for a quiet retirement away from the hustle of civic life. However, the peace you sought is shattered when a wave of cursed spirits begin to emerge from the once tranquil forests of Sanctuary. It is now up to you to return to Anzen and connect with its inhabitants to unravel the mysteries behind the unrest.

Will you be able to uncover the sinister forces that lie beneath and restore harmony to Anzen? 

Embark on a journey of casual exploration through a large unique map, brimming with charming characters and captivating scenery. This leisurely experience offers mild combat, light puzzles, and hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.

448911.overview:
The third entry in the Mega Man World series gets a coat of paint! Enjoy another blue bomber classic in full color and defeat Wily one more time with colorful backgrounds along gameplay fixes and enhancements.

FEATURES

* full color conversion
* slowdowns removed
* NES styled pause screen
* hitbox and animation fixes
* works in real GBC hardware and emulators

451164.overview: EJRTQ converts Metroid II to full color. This mod combines the art of the beautiful but buggy EJRT colorization 1.2 with entirely rewritten code, fixing bugs and crashes, allowing it to run on most emulators, and adding additional graphical improvements.

451461.overview:
This is a full GBC conversion for Mega Man World 2 by SpecialAgentApe, with an included soundtrack hack by forple.

Features:
Full color conversion
Soundtrack selector: Press the Select Button on the title screen to switch between a remixed OST and the original OST.
Redone soundtrack by forple also includes redone sound effects; those wishing for the original experience can disable it.
Slide and tiptoe graphics corrected

New sprite animations added:
Mega Man blinks while riding Rush Marine
Mega Man’s damage animation now has an extra frame
Energy tank’s “E” blinks on and off like the other entries in the series
New tile animations added:
Metal Man’s, Top Man’s, and Air Man’s stages have received animations and graphical touch-ups similar to their NES counterparts
The magnet generators in Magnet Man’s stage are now animated
Water is now animated in every level containing it
Redone graphics:

The final boss’s graphics have been redrawn by Kensuyjin33 to be more on-model with the rest of the series
The Mag Fly enemy was redrawn to be more on-model while retaining its hitbox
Redone pause menu and icons, along with weapon colors
Bugs fixed:

Mini-bosses in Wood Man’s and Top Man’s stages now disappear when you change screens while they are onscreen
Other changes and features:

Quint’s arena now plays the boss theme
The sky in Crash Man’s stage now changes with Mega Man’s elevation to mimic the effect seen in the NES title
Using Hard Knuckle now makes Mega Man’s hand disappear, rather than him firing it from his gun
Please check the included readme for known issues and compatibility info for the current version.

451547.overview: This is a GB to GBC conversion hack for Mega Man: Wily’s Revenge, the first in the Mega Man World series.

452246.overview:
My Friendly Little Island is a cute game about personal growth and making friends. It starts out as a slow, simplistic adventure game. However, with every new skill you unlock, the game’s dynamics change more and more into a fast-paced platformer.

  - Unlock new skills to fully explore your island
  -  Help new friends and populate your village
  -  Feel the music become livelier with every new villager
  -  Change your looks with cosmetic items
  -  Experience the day-night cycle
  -  30-60 minutes of playtime until the credits roll
  - Save feature unlocked early into the game
  -   Lots of coconuts :)

454470.overview: What a peaceful day! As the sun sets and the moon begins to shine its light over the village, a young witch finishes her busy day of potion making by hanging her hat and going to bed. Her cat, Mona, doesn't want to go to bed though. She's more interested in the treats the Witch left out! But things don't go as planned when the Witch's hat falls on Mona's head and everything comes to life. Now she has to turn everything back to normal!

454865.overview: Mega Man World 4 DX is a hack of Mega Man IV (1993) created by Marc Max and Kensuyjin33 that converts this game developed by Minakuchi Engineering (Solar Striker, Rabio Lepus Special, Bionic Commando (Game Boy), Magic Sword (SNES) combining contents of Mega Man 4 and Mega Man 5 from NES into a Game Boy Color game, working as a hypothetical re-release like The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX that adds color and improves performance by eliminating slowdowns, as well as other improvements such as a new pause screen based on the style of the NES games.

460029.overview: Confront the Mobsters from the other Pizzeria in town to recover the stolen GOLDEN PIZZA with the secret pizza formula. Controll Giuseppe Tortelinni thru the streets in this crazy adventure!

460321.overview: Play as Marron, a young bunny, and help the cute animal friends in town so that they'll sign up for stalls at the town festival! Enjoy the cosy and retro pixel art graphics as you explore the town.

460323.overview: Metamorphosis Collection is a horror anthology that includes the following games on a single ROM/cartridge: Opossum Country, Decline, Specimen 134

460398.overview: This is a homebrew game, run on Gameboy Color. Original version by Mark J Moore - Gremlin Graphics. Commodore 16/Plus4, 1986.

462059.overview:
Mole Mania is a cult classic puzzle game for the original Game Boy.
Guide Muddy Mole through more than 200 screens full of puzzles to rescue his family from Jinbe the farmer.

The remastered version allows you to enjoy the game in full color for the first time ever in 30 years!

463633.overview:
The day the machines ravaged the sky and the earth, they took absolute control.

Humanity was subdued and enslaved. Music was eradicated and replaced with an alienating noise.

Fortunately, a group of true survivors, leaders of the Metal Resistance, continue fighting to recover the Primordial Melody. Only with it will they free human minds and destroy the army of bots that now dominate the planet.

We control Fox or Ace, two warriors with unique powers. The choice is yours!

464366.overview: It's button pattern pandemonium in Memory Mania Challenge!  Pay attention to the button pattern and try your best to repeat it.  It starts off easy, but things can quickly get out of hand.  Beat the top score and become the new champion!

465001.overview:
A fan demake of the first 3-5 minutes of the game up to the first E.M.M.I. encounter.

Made with GB Studio 2 beta 5. A submission on the port-a-game-to-the-gameboy jam

466747.overview:
Select a Grimoire that contains the power of a magical beast, and wear its power to advance through the stage and defeat the deepest bosses.
You cannot select a Grimoire other than the initial state (NONE) at first. By clearing the stage, you can seal the boss in the Grimoire and use the power of the Grimoire. 
After clearing all 6 stages, a stage select mode will open, allowing you to choose your favorite Grimoire to play any stage.

*CAUTION*

This game contains mild NSFW contents.

466766.overview: This game was made for an art contest about the upcoming Steam game (which is by Yacht Club of Shovel Knight fame), and works on an actual GBA!
